A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''alien philosopher''' was part of the crew of the [[Scientist/Legends|science]] [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] ''[[Prana Lexander]]'' five hundred [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was considered to be one of his [[Species/Legends|species]]' greatest minds. The ship was lost, but the [[Philosopher/Legends|philosopher]] survived aboard the ship in [[Suspended animation/Legends|cyrofreeze]] until he was freed by [[Agent/Legends|agents]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. They told the philosopher of their struggle against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and he agreed to help them by returning to his people and enlisting them as allies. Arriving at his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], the ship the philosopher was traveling on was ordered to be inspected by [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|Imperial Customs]]. The Alliance agents hid the philosopher, but he was found by the leader of the Imperial boarding party, [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Brawk]]. The Alliance agents paid a 2,500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] bribe to the officer to be allowed to continue.<ref name="RPG" />
